What's under the hood
01
Multi-entity consolidation. Every ticket carries a source_entity field, so tickets from different companies, franchises, or systems live in one table and one dashboard.
02
Cascading filters. Picking a source entity narrows the team filter to only teams active for that entity — never an empty, confusing dropdown.
03
Live, cached queries. Ticket data is read straight from SQLite and cached for 30 seconds, so charts stay current without hammering the database on every interaction.
